newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: PM BLOCKS KLAIPEDA TRANSPORT CAPITAL BOOST.
newsitem.headline: PM BLOCKS KLAIPEDA TRANSPORT CAPITAL BOOST.

text.p: Lithuanian Prime Minister Gediminas Vagnorius vetoed on Monday the share capital boost from additional funds by Klaipeda Transport Fleet, the government's office said.
The government said in a statement that it blocked the increase in reserves from additional funds and allowed the capital rise from the company's own reserves.

"It is planned to decide on the boost of the present 85.5 million litas share capital of the company by 14.5 million litas during the general shareholders' meeting on March 26," government's official Zhenius Povilavichius told Reuters.
The statement also said the government asked the agricultural and forestry ministry to submit the state shares of Klaipedos transport fleet for privatisation in 1997.
"The state runs 44.7 percent of company's shares," Povilavichius added.
